relations.source_passage_locator: Kathirithamby-Wells 1976, Indonesia No.21, p.74 (flight to Salida, Nov 1662, seeking VOC assistance amid succession crisis); linimasa_events.csv row 34 (source '1663 92', event date 4 Nov 1662, reported Batavia 27 Mar 1663: 'Indrapoura (Malafarcha & Sultan Mametcha) ikut lepas dari Atjeh').
relations.source_statement_summary: Row 34: 'Indrapoura (Malafarcha & Sultan Mametcha) ikut lepas dari Atjeh', dated 4 Nov 1662 (reported 27 Mar 1663). K-W 1976 p.74: Muhammad Syah and his father fled to Salida in Nov 1662 to seek VOC assistance amid an 11-of-20-menteri revolt backing Raja Adil.
relations.historical_reconstruction: Read together, these two independently-provenanced sources are consistent with Muhammad Syah's faction approaching VOC for backing in the same window as its documented exit from Aceh's authority. The exact request content (military backing? recognition? both?) is not itemized in either source at this stage — this is treated as a general protection request, not a fully specified bargain (the bargain's terms appear later, §R2/R3).
relations.theoretical_annotation: First-dimension power reading: local-actor agency in initiating contact with an external patron candidate, consistent with the deep dive's client-agency finding (§14) that this faction demonstrably chose among patrons rather than passively receiving protection.
relations.public_display_summary: Inderapura's ruling faction sought VOC support in 1662 amid an internal succession dispute.
relations.notes: claim_or_effective_control set to UNKNOWN_EFFECTIVE_CONTROL because a request, prior to any grant, does not itself assert or exercise a claim; this value is the closest fit within the 10-value controlled vocabulary, not a claim that control status is genuinely contested. researcher_review_required=true solely for the row-34 name-variant identity caveat carried on the Muhammad Syah faction actor record, not for this relation's own sourcing quality.

K-W 1976 p.74 states exclusive pepper rights were the explicit exchange condition for restoration backing. relations.notes: claim_or_effective_control=TREATY_OBLIGATION deliberately distinguishes the STATED obligation from its effective enforcement, which is recorded separately (see REL_CLAIMS_JURISDICTION_OVER_VOC__MUHAMMAD_SYAH_FACTION below, claim_or_effective_control=CONTESTED_CONTROL). researcher_review_required=true both for the rows-44/45 Mametchia name-variant caveat (shared with the Muhammad Syah faction actor record) and because this record's valid_to is deliberately left open pending researcher decision on how far past 1667 the monopoly obligation should be considered still in force for MVP purposes.
